🎬 Slipaway (2017)

Slipaway tells the heartwarming story of Fall, an elderly woman living aboard a sailboat who forms an unexpected friendship with Adam, a struggling young musician facing homelessness. When their paths cross, Fall offers Adam a place to stay in exchange for helping her with everyday responsibilities aboard her boat. Despite their differences in age, background, and life experiences, the two gradually develop a meaningful connection that transforms their lives. As Adam struggles with personal hardships and uncertainty about his future, Fall encourages him to rediscover his passion for music and find hope in unexpected places. Their growing friendship reveals the importance of human connection, compassion, and finding purpose even during life’s most difficult moments. Starring Elaine Partnow and Jesse Pepe, the film delivers touching performances and emotional storytelling about loneliness, friendship, aging, kindness, and the extraordinary impact two strangers can have on each other’s lives.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family • Independent Film

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 29m • TV-14

🎥 Directors: Julia Butler & Daniel Mentz

✍️ Writers: Julia Butler & Daniel Mentz

📺 Where to Watch: Tubi, Plex, and Fawesome (free streaming), Amazon Prime Video and Fandango at Home (rental or purchase).
